articles.title_en: Russian bank apps, telecom services, and Rostelecom home internet go down in widespread outages
articles.lead_en: Websites and apps belonging to banks, telecom operators, satellite companies, and other organizations in Russia went down on the evening of April 6, according to posts on the Telegram channel of the Russian outage-tracking service Sboi.rf (Outage.ru). The cause of the disruptions was not immediately known.
